title: Mixed Event — Show Your Shine

meta.Outline: On her way to replace her torn jacket at the mall, Kanade has an encounter with Saki that leads to them setting up a teatime chat. That's when Saki asks her to be the model for her fashion project, of all things...!

rows.Line: Yoisaki Household - Outside the Entrance

rows.Speaker: Delivery Person
rows.Line: Alright, if you'll excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Here we...go...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Phew...
When was the last time I bought new clothes like this?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was bought that jacket when I was still in junior high school. It was so comfortable that I ended up wearing it until I poked a hole in one of the pockets...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I tried ordering something that had good reviews online, so let's see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's not as warm as I'd hoped...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I made a mistake...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What do I do? It's been really cold lately, so I'd like to have a new jacket handy...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But it's going to take time for whatever I order to get delivered. Plus, I don't want to get the wrong thing again...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Looks like I'm left with no choice but to go to the store...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm visiting Dad tomorrow, so...
I can stop by the mall on my way home.
The next day
Main Street
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, it's so cold...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'll quickly buy a jacket and head straight home.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (There's a bit of a crowd, but I should be able to use this street as a shortcut to get to the mall.)

rows.Speaker: New Hairstylist
rows.Line: Oh, you there! Hello!

rows.Speaker: New Hairstylist
rows.Line: Do you happen to have some time right now?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, are you talking to me...?

rows.Speaker: New Hairstylist
rows.Line:
Yes!
Would you be interested in becoming a haircut model?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A haircut model...?

rows.Speaker: New Hairstylist
rows.Line: Yes, I work at the salon just over there!

rows.Speaker: New Hairstylist
rows.Line: The second I saw your gorgeous hair, I just knew I had to ask you!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I...

rows.Speaker: New Hairstylist
rows.Line:
Oh, your haircut will be free of charge!
You'll even get whatever hair treatments you like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Th-That's a really generous offer, but... What should I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If I go to the salon, I might not have enough energy left to go buy a new jacket...)
Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting.
And sorry I'm late...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Tenma...?

rows.Speaker: New Hairstylist
rows.Line:
Oh, you were waiting for your friend...!
I apologize for interrupting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, you don't need to apologize!

rows.Speaker: New Hairstylist
rows.Line:
But here's the salon's card.
Please consider stopping by later if you're interested!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you♪
Anyway, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh... O-Okay...
se_walk_women_001_2
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... I'm really sorry about just now!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You looked like you were in trouble, Kanade... I mean, Yoisaki... That's why I thought I had to step in and help...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope I didn't get the wrong idea...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I see...
She jumped in to help by acting like we were supposed to meet there.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I really appreciate what you did.
Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Also, Kanade...
No, I did it again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm really sorry. Ichi always calls you by your first name, and I think that's rubbed off on me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's okay.
You can call me by my first name if you like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, umm...!
Were you about to go somewhere, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I was thinking about going to the mall.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Me too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to see what kinds of scarves they have since it's been so cold lately.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it has been very cold...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm thinking about buying a new jacket.
Unfortunately, I poked a hole in my current one...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A new jacket...! That should be fun!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Isn't it exciting shopping for new clothes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I always have so much fun thinking about which style to get and imagining how it's going to go with my current outfits...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's fun to think about that...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm a little jealous, since I'm not all that particular when it comes to clothes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I do look for things that are easy to maintain and move around in, but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I almost prefer to just wear the clothes that other people recommend me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Umm...
You don't have to let me if you don't feel comfortable...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But can I help you pick out your new jacket?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Kanade!
This shop carries lots of different types of outerwear!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wow, you're right...
I don't even know where to begin...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
They seem to be sorted based on category.
This looks like the corner for basic coats, and those are all casual jackets...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, look at this boa fleece! It's so fluffy and adorable!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was a little worried that she wouldn't get to have much fun helping me shop...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's even reversible!
And both colors are really cute!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I guess my worries were misplaced.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, I shouldn't be the one having all the fun. I almost forgot that we're here to find you a new jacket, Kanade...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did you have any particular styles or traits in mind?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
So, above all else, it needs to be warm...
But not too heavy, if possible.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What else...? It'd be nice if it were made of a material that's easy to maintain. Also, a simple design would be preferable.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I see.
In other words, it needs to be comfortable and easy to keep clean!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, we might want to try going over to the outdoor goods shop...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The outdoor goods?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! Recently, all the big outdoor brands have been making really cute clothes that you can wear day to day!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had no idea. Then, why don't we go take a look?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... Would you mind showing me the way?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course♪ It's right this way!
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here we are! What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, these come in simple designs...
I could wear these like normal.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. See what I mean?
All that's left is to find something that's both warm and light...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, what about this down jacket?
It's fluffy but not heavy, and seems really warm!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. It shouldn't be all that taxing to wear this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, these overcoats also seem pretty versatile!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You can block the wind and stay warm by popping the collar... Hey, it even says that you can throw it in a washing machine!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you don't have to send it to the dry cleaners...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Pretty incredible, right?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know. If you're interested in any of these, then why don't you try them on? We can try asking the staff.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, let's do that.
Umm... Excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: Thank you!
se_walk_women_002_2
se_walk_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm glad you were able to find a jacket you like!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it, Tenma.
There's no telling how long that would've taken if I were by myself. Honestly, I might've gotten exhausted and picked something just to be done...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ It's nice to know that you should be able to have a warm and cozy winter now♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, you've been a tremendous help.
Which is why I'd like to repay the favor somehow...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, you don't have to do that!
I wanted to help you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, while looking around with you, I ended up finding a really cute scarf♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not only that, I had a really fun time today thanks to you, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because you're able to pull off whatever you wear! I really enjoyed watching you try on different clothes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, there's no need to pay me back!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, if you're sure...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sure! Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If possible...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I would like to chat with you some more, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: With me...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! Ichi and Hona have already told me so much about you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've been hoping that we'd get a chance to sit down and chat!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't guarantee that we're going to strike up a good conversation. So, as long as you're okay with that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You mean it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, but I have work after this...!
Can we meet again sometime soon?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
Then, we should probably swap our contact info!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... I forget how to actually do that on this device...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You tap here, hit this mark and...
Oh, there we go!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I can add you as a friend now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
All done!
Hehe. Thank you again so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll message you later!
We can go to a cafe or something!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. Have fun at work.
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I really can't thank Tenma enough...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't know if chatting with me will make up for what she did today...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I am sort of looking forward to talking to her again...
Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, thanks for waiting. I'm back.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, Amia, welcome back...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What were you doing just now?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I went to grab a blanket.
And a toasty drink while I was at it♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, it has been freezing lately.
It's hard to work at night without those things...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Really?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, aren't you cold? I mean, if I don't turn the heater on, I can't draw because my hand becomes completely frozen!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I guess artists do have it pretty rough this time of year. But speaking of how cold it's been...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You said you were gonna buy a new jacket, K. Did you already get one?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, yes... I managed to get one.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <What's more, while I was walking over to the mall today...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Really?! And Saki helped you pick it out?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, she helped me find a good one after asking me about my preferences. I really can't thank her enough...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, I'm just as surprised that you went out to buy new clothes yourself, K...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Still, a jacket from an outdoor goods shop... I wouldn't have thought of that, but it probably does suit you really well.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Especially since they make stuff with cute designs now♪ I might go over sometime to try and dig up a few hidden gems.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Hm? My phone says I have a message.
But from who...?)

rows.Speaker: Message from Saki
rows.Line:
<Thank you again for today, Kanade!
I had a lot of fun shopping with you♪>

rows.Speaker: Message from Saki
rows.Line: <If possible, would you like to go to a cafe with Ichi and me sometime?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(It's from Tenma...
And she's already inviting me to meet with her again.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Is something wrong, K...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I received a message from Tenma...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She asked if I'd like to go to a cafe with her and Hoshino.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, that's great♪
Saki's really nice, so I'm sure you two will hit it off!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She even went out of her way to make sure Ichika would be there. That's pretty sharp of her.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sharp...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <You'll have an easier time talking to her if someone you both know is also there, no...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, right...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Then, before I forget, I'll reply to her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, what are you gonna say?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <“Thank you very much for inviting me”...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'd go with something a little more casual.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <More casual...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Then... “Sounds good”?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That should work...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's sent...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Now I'm really looking forward to talking to her again...)
A few days later
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ahem...
Thank you all very much for agreeing to gather here today!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Uhh... You're welcome?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is how Saki always acts, so please feel free to talk like you usually do, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I'm just really happy about the three of us meeting together like this today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've been wanting to ask you all about songwriting and stuff, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Songwriting... That's right, I got to listen to the song you made for Shibu Schools Fest before.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It was a good song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, thank you so much!
Your advice ended up being huge since it was my first time writing a song for a musical!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You see things from a different perspective, Kanade... You caught things that we missed, and we learned so much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. It's nice to hear that I was able to help, even just a little...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I'm so glad that I got to thank you again like this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, when it comes to songwriting...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see. So, movies and manga are sometimes the sources of inspiration for your songs!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, as well as art.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It could be the feel of a particular piece, or just me wondering why the artist chose to draw it the way they did... I try to turn those feelings into sound.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll try to watch more movies and look at more works of art moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I might start doing that as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. Our conversation just reminded me about something interesting we were recently assigned for art class.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about that art project?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Art project?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes! The theme is “radiance”.
We're supposed to create something...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were told that as long as it keeps with the theme, we can go with a drawing, a sculpture, a movie or any other medium!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, interesting... Does that mean a song also works?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Unfortunately, a song alone isn't allowed since it's for art class.
But a video that incorporates one is, or a children's book that makes sounds, for example.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
That sounds difficult, but also really fun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Have you two already decided what you're going to make?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm thinking about drawing Miku.
I thought I should take this opportunity to try doing something I normally don't.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A drawing of Miku seems like the perfect choice for you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm thinking about a fashion piece that involves designing an outfit, as well as doing hair and makeup!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your piece is going to involve all three...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes!
Our art teacher showed us some of the things that former students made in the past.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was when I found a picture of someone wearing an outfit her friend had coordinated according to the theme. The designer even did her hair and makeup...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I also saw that, and it was gorgeous.
She looked like a professional model...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I wanna try doing that!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You seem to know quite a lot about fashion, Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm really not that knowledgeable!
But I do like following what's in and watching makeup videos.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to make the most of this opportunity and do something challenging!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You have been really excited ever since we left art class that day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By the way, have you already found a model?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh... No, not yet...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Are you not allowed to be your own model, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, that's allowed.
But I'm hoping to find someone to model for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I kind of have this rough idea of what I want to do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I wouldn't be able to pull off that look in a million years.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I was hoping to find a model who can...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What's wrong, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She's the answer...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Umm, Kanade...?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I know this is asking a lot of you, and feel free to say no...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But would it be possible for you to be my model?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm having trouble putting it into words...
But you possess the exact sort of radiance that I'm trying to capture!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I've never done any modeling before...
I'm not sure I'll be able to do your piece justice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Not a problem!
If it's you, Kanade... I just know that you'll do an amazingly good job!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh no! I'm sorry!
I didn't mean to startle you or anything...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Me? As a model...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I honestly don't think I'm cut out to be one...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But Tenma helped me a lot the other day, so I do want to return the favor somehow.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay...
If you believe I'm the right person...then I accept.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: R-Really?! Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I still don't know if I'll do a good job...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I promise to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I...! I promise I'll find a way to make you as radiant and brilliant as possible!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
But please go easy on me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll need some time to pick out an outfit and practice doing hair and makeup...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I'll let you know when I've got my plan of action!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, is there anything I need to do on my end...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Nope! You don't have to lift a finger!
I'll take care of your outfit and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kanade as a model...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You have me curious now...
Would it be alright if I came and watched?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't mind. Would that be okay, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, that's totally okay!
So, Ichi, I'll also let you know when everything is ready!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I'm actually pretty excited.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Me... As a model...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Will I really be able to pull it off...?)
A few days later
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... Pardon the intrusion.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Pardon us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Enter!
Welcome, Kanade, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you again for agreeing to come all this way, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I promise to really capture your radiance today!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you for having me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I'm a little nervous...
I hardly ever go over to other people's houses.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I was just marveling at how well-organized your room is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? You really mean that?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, my room is so cluttered...
Things literally come crashing down on top of me sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! I hope you've never gotten hurt!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, since it's never anything heavy...
Mostly sheet music and cardboard boxes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Once I find the inspiration for a song, I'll start working on that right away and make things like cleaning my room take a back seat.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I understand what you mean.
It's like nothing else matters besides the song you're writing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. I have this habit of throwing everything into my closet when I don't really have time. Unfortunately for me, that's resulted in a few avalanches.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Please, sit down! You two don't have to keep standing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've also prepared snacks and drinks, so have as much as you like!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh wow...
It's like we're having a little party...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? This pile of magazines...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh! They're the fashion magazines I've gathered!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember the pictures I took of you the other day after we left the cafe, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, yes...
You said you were going to use them to prepare for today...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's right!
I found a cool trick in this one video I saw...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You print out pictures of your friend and place them where a model's face is supposed to go, and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh wow.
It's like she's all dressed up now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This helps you get a clear picture of what your friend would look like wearing a particular outfit!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That is pretty cool. I might give this a try with my own picture sometime...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You totally should!
This is so much easier than trying on clothes at an actual shop, which means more fun combinations to test!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I tried mixing and matching different pieces of outfits using this trick...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, there's a sticky note on this page...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. This is my first candidate!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought the idea of having a monotone outfit accented by flashy accessories was kinda cool.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is pretty cool...
It's like something a rock star would wear.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you really think I'll be able to pull this off...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know you will!
Oh, but this one's a bit more girly!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it's cute. Like one of those poofy dresses you see on dolls.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I think Mizuki would really like this one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I thought the same thing♪
You can make it even cuter by adding a brooch to this hat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, if you're feeling brave, I thought we could also try a sporty look...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm hoping that we can take pictures of you wearing a few of these outfits!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, that seems fine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't know much about fashion, but I do think that you'll look good in all of these, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! I've even come up with hairstyles and makeup ideas for each one♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know.
Can I try doing your hair right now, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't mind, but I'm still in my sweats. Is that okay...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! I want to take this opportunity to get a feel for your hair!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's see... I have my brush, hairpins and...
Oh, am I gonna need oil for this?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki's so excited...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I know that she wants to do well on her project...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But she must love fashion very much.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll start by combing your bangs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'm ready whenever...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Your hair's so silky and smooth, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's also super long. Isn't maintaining it really hard?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I don't actually do much to maintain it...
It's also long because that's just easier for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, your hair's naturally this silky smooth...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's incredible...
My hair's been sorta wavy since I was little, so I have this fascination with perfectly straight hair.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I like your hair, Saki.
It's so fluffy and soft.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. It matches your personality really well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But a part of me has always wanted to do something about my wavy hair. That's why I began learning what I could about styling from magazines and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because when you get your hair and outfit just right, it's like a sign that you're going to have a great day!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (A sign that you're going to have a great day...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've never seen things from that sort of perspective before.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm thinking about going with a half-up, half-down hairstyle that flows naturally.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If you had your choice of ringlets or buns, which would you prefer?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Uhh... I'll leave that up to you.
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So many people...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's incredible how they're all able to withstand this cold weather.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... Sorry, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, where are we going today again?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This new makeup lounge that opened just recently!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to test out some things before our shoot, so... Oh, this is it!
Makeup Lounge

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's so glittery...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Isn't this place incredible?!
You can try out all the cosmetics you want for one hour with just one coin♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, I honestly had no idea that a place like this existed...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, it's just...
Now I sort of wish there was a place where you could freely try out musical instruments and equipment.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Most shops will let you if you ask the staff, but you only ever get to play for a few minutes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right.
However, I may just be uninformed. An instrument lounge like that may already exist...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You have me curious now!
Let's look that up later!
A few more days later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <And guess what? Mizuki and Shizuku agreed to lend me some of their clothes too!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<They did?
Yes, those two do both seem to have extensive wardrobes.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Exactly! They really saved the day since they had just the kinds of clothes I was hoping to use!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Anyway, now I know what I'm going to have you wear...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Which brings me to...! Our special guest!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Special guest?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <That's right! She's one of my friends from school, and she agreed to help out after I told her about my project.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <So, without further ado, from all the way in the United States, it's... Kohane!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: <H-Hello...!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Umm... Can you two see me okay?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Yeah, we see you just fine!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Hehe. Thank goodness.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Hello, Yoisaki.
Oh, wait a second... Maybe “good evening” is more appropriate based on what time it is in Japan right now...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Umm... Hello.
You perform in the same team as Ena's brother, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Yes, my name is Kohane Azusawa.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Kohane's a really amazing photographer!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <So, today, I'm hoping to get as much advice from her as possible on taking good pictures!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I see...
Then, Azusawa, thank you for joining us.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <I-I'm really not as good as she makes me out to be...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <But I will try to help in any way I can.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Thanks, Kohane!
Then, I'll start by asking...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <How do you take good portraits of people?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Portraits...?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Well, I suppose it's important to choose a good location and a plan for bringing your subject's charm to the surface.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Yes, I see.
Bring Kanade's charm to the surface somehow...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Also, since your project already has a specific theme attached to it... You may want to find a way to factor that in somehow.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Factor in the theme?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Yes. When I entered into this photography contest for Valentine's Day a while back...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Thanks, Kohane!
I have a much better idea of how to take the pictures I want now!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you for also going into detail regarding what a model needs to do during a shoot.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <I'm glad that I was able to help.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Good luck, you two.
I hope your project turns out really well!>
A few days later
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was a great shoot!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Great shoot to you as well, Tenma.
We ended up taking quite a few pictures. Did any immediately stand out to you...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, you looked so amazing in every outfit that I'm having trouble deciding which picture to use!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I printed them out, so could we take a look together?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is also your chance to let me know if you see any that you don't want me to use.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was worried that I'd made some funny faces since I'm not used to having my picture taken...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But thank goodness. My expressions look more natural than I was expecting.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can't thank Azusawa enough for the advice she gave me. And Tenma did a good job of helping me relax during the shoot by talking to me...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I've looked through all of them now, and I didn't see any problems.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which means, Tenma, all that's left is for you to choose...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Tenma...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh...? Oh, I'm sorry!
Did you find any problems at all?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I didn't notice anything...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry, did they not turn out the way you hoped?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't apologize!
You did nothing wrong, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's just...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Umm... This is probably going to sound a little strange...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But something is missing.
Do you know what I mean...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Missing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (As far as I can see, nothing appears to be missing.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is there something in particular that you're not happy with...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry if I misspoke...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This is just my gut feeling, but you seem to be hung up on something, Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hung up... That'd be an exaggeration...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's just...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I feel like there's something I can do to make you even more radiant, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even more radiant...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Take this picture for example.
I chose this outfit with the goal of drawing out your mysterious side.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And this one was supposed to capture the kindness you showed when you helped us with our songs for Shibu Schools Fest...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They all have elements of the radiance I see in you... So, I don't know why I'm feeling this way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Tenma knows what she's trying to capture. If she still feels like there's something missing, then...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Could my inexperience as a model be the problem...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You really did do an amazing job, Kanade! You looked cool, cute and super duper ridiculously gorgeous in every picture!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, not at all...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That feeling of what you're trying to capture being just barely out of your grasp...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Why does that seem so familiar...?
I feel like I understand what she's going through.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(That's right...
I experience the same thing sometimes when I'm composing a song.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'll have a message or theme solidly in mind but struggle to express it properly...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (A process of trial and error will produce a few possible solutions, but none will seem right...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Tenma might be going through the same thing right now.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Then, all I can do now is...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I understand...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
This is just my guess...
But I think you should trust your sense that something is missing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because I'll find myself feeling the same way sometimes when I'm composing a song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I'm willing to continue helping you until you've taken a picture that captures what you feel is missing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?! A-Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. You still have time until you have to turn in your project...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I agreed to help you...
So I want to see this through until the end.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Kanade... Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If you'll bear with me for just a bit longer!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Let's do our best, Tenma...
A few days later
Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright, this seems like a good place for me to stop today!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I think I'll stop here too.
I have work tomorrow, and it's been a little while since I last went.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. Thank you for your hard work, everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Later♪>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you going to keep working, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to make a little more progress while I can.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay. Good night...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Good night, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, a message...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (No, it's just a newsletter. I thought it was...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I still haven't heard back from her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope Tenma's okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm going to take another hard look at what I think makes you really shine, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That might be the key to figuring out what I'm missing!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What if she's really struggling to find the answer?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I said that I'd help her until the end, but I haven't been able to do anything for her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This isn't good. I can't focus on my work at all...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe I should take a short break in SEKAI...
Empty SEKAI
Lake
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (There's someone over by the water...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kanade? When did you get here...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Just now. I came to take a short break.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your timing couldn't have been better.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is my brooch crooked at all...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I tried using the water as a mirror, but I couldn't really tell...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... It looks straight to me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay. That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your brooch is very pretty.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mizuki found it at a shop, thought it would look good on me and decided to bring it over.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I felt like wearing it today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. Mizuki would be so happy to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you wear any jewelry like this, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mizuki and the others said that you were modeling for someone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did you put on any jewelry during your shoot?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Brooches, necklaces and a variety of other things.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, no...
Nothing too serious. It's just...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Things haven't been going so well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
We did our shoot the other day...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Tenma said that I possess the sort of radiance she's looking for...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we weren't able to fully capture that in any of the pictures we took. And that's bothering her...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Radiance...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
She said she's going to take another hard look at what that means to her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I also understand that feeling that your piece is incomplete because you're missing something.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was hoping to help her somehow, but I really don't know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
What would you do in this sort of situation, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You can't expect me to immediately answer that question...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, of course. I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wouldn't know what to do either...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This is like the opposite of how things usually go.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The opposite...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. Whenever you have trouble reaching someone with a song or don't know what you're trying to express to them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You try to get to know that person, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You're right...
When I first decided to try to compose a song that could save Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I started by taking a closer look at what she was thinking and feeling...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I did overstep a few times as a result...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I was also able to learn more about what's really going on with Mafuyu. I figured out what I wanted to do and channeled it into my songs...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Well, if you don't know, then you should go find out...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That can change things a lot, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see your point. This is sort of the opposite of how things usually go.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't know if this will help Tenma find the right answer.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But if I can give her even the smallest hint...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I really appreciate it, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I know what to do now thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let me know if the picture turns out. I wanna see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll bring it by once it's ready.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll be waiting...
The next day
Diner

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you meet me on such short notice, Tenma. But thank you for coming.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, you don't need to apologize!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... You wanted to talk to me about my project today, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry!
I haven't been able to figure out what I need to do...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I know what you're going through isn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But there is something I'd like for you to try, Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Something you want me to try...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I have no idea if this is going to work...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I want you to know more about me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: About you, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're trying to capture the radiance you say that I possess...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we still don't know much about each other since we only started talking just recently.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think that's why you feel like you're missing something.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Obviously, getting to know me might not solve everything.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But would you be willing to give this a try?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I haven't been able to fully bring out the radiance within you because I still don't know who you are as a person.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's give it a try!
Please tell me more about yourself, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. Unfortunately, I really don't know what I should talk about...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, could you ask me any questions that come to mind?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No problem!
Oh, but you don't have to answer if you don't feel comfortable.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's see...
To start, what's your favorite food?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Instant noodles and canned foods, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They're easy to prepare, which leaves me with more time to work on composing songs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, interesting...!
I also get these huge cravings for instant noodles sometimes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, do you have any favorite flavors or anything?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I have soy sauce and salt flavors the most...
But I basically like them all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Oh, do you like your noodles firm or soft?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I don't know. I've never actually thought about that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I usually just set a timer in my head for three minutes like the instructions say, so I can't say that I have a particular preference...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, a timer in your head...? You mean you can tell how long it's been without using a real one?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, yes. But I lose track over longer periods...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Th-That's so cool!
I wish I had that sort of superpower!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That counts as a superpower...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, it absolutely does!
Then, next...
What are your best and worst subjects in school?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
My best is... Music?
And my worst is PE.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I see.
Huh? Wait a second...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aren't you enrolled in a correspondence school, Kanade? Do you guys even have PE?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, we're required to get a certain number of credits...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, really...?!
I had no idea!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, I'm able to do everything online... And as long as I make sure to do my coursework, I get to spend the rest of my time composing. So, I'm glad I decided to enroll in a correspondence school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You get to spend the rest of your time composing...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean you're always working on a song when you're at home?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, basically.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I didn't know that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry, but can I ask you something else?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What does music mean to you, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: As long as music exists, I need to keep composing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have to compose songs that can save others.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Those who are in pain or feeling sad...
I need to keep creating in order to help as many of them as I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I wish I could explain it better, but that's genuinely how I feel about music...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Songs that can save others...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Actually, would it be alright if I listened to one of your group's songs right now?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh?
Yes, of course...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Let's see... Where's the video that Ichi sent me the other day?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Would you like to use my phone instead?
It should come right up on it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Tenma's listening so intently...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That sound right there was uncanny...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It felt like something out of a deep, dark abyss... This is nothing like the songs we write.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It's beautiful and a little scary... But there's also this kindness to it.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Kanade is probably able to produce these sorts of songs because...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have to compose songs that can save others.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Tenma...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I think I understand now.
I think I know how to capture your radiance!
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'll have you wear this and this...
And these accessories...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Wow, it's like she knows exactly what to pick now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This must mean...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She's figured out what she wants to do.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting!
Everything's all set, so can you change into this for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do I look okay...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Perfect! Next, can you take a seat here? I'll be doing your hair and makeup now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm going to use this iron to make your hair look wavy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My goal is to make you look delicate and dignified... But kind and soft at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It sounds like you know exactly how you're going to do my hair...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I do!
And I have you to thank, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The more you told me about yourself, the clearer what I had to do became.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm excited beyond belief right now!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad I was able to help...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know! You don't have to if you don't want to, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But would you mind closing your eyes until I've finished doing your hair and makeup?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's hard not to look in the mirror when you're sitting in front of a dressing table...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think it'd be more fun for you to wait and see what you look like once I'm all done!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then, please tell me once you've finished.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you♪
I'll let you know when I'm done.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just put on a bit of pale-colored lip gloss and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, I'm done!
Oh, but don't open your eyes yet.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll hold your hand, so stand up and walk this way with me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, you can open your eyes now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It might be strange for me to say this, but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I look...really pretty, I think.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know the first thing when it comes to fashion...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I can tell that something is different about me compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I realized something while talking to you, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That the radiance I was looking for is the same as the songs you compose.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My songs...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes.
You said your goal is to compose songs that can help those who are in pain or feeling sad...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You want to save them, so that they feel happy... That kindness is what makes your music.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's just what I felt!
I'm sorry if I jumped to the wrong conclusion...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I really was blown away by your kindness, Kanade. In a way, it was blinding...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why I thought it was the source of the radiance I see in you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I see...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This is what Tenma was trying to capture...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now I feel really happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's nice to think that my song made you feel this way, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Kanade, do that again...!
Can you make that face for me one more time?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You made such a great expression just now. I want to take a picture!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: W-Wait, just now...? What kind of expression did I make...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You smiled and glowed like crazy!
A few days later
Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew... This seems like a good place to take a short break.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That reminds me...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I haven't heard back from her since then. I wonder how her project went.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? A message...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line:
<Hello, Kanade!
I'm sorry for not getting back to you sooner.>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <Thank you again for helping me before!>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <I was able to produce an amazing picture because of you, and my art teacher even gave me a ton of praise.>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <But the parts that made me the happiest were how I was able to fully capture what I was after...>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <And when you said that you looked pretty!>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line:
<So, thank you so very much!
I'll send my picture over to you now, so please take a look at it when you get a chance♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Here's her picture...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Again, I'm having trouble recognizing myself...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: “I'm glad I was able to help you, Tenma.” There.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? She already replied...?

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <I'd love to do more dress-up days now and again, if you're okay with it!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: “Maybe every once in a while.”
